representedDate: Standing 18th-century casona, as the courtyard facade was recorded in the cleared photograph uploaded in 2010 and is documented by the museum today.
wholePhysicalScope: Native fourteen-edge mansion polygon, attached visitor approach, mapped door and adjacent garden controls.
lodDetails: All levels retain the mapped casona, raised approach, recessed door and curved plaster pediment. Near levels add plaster mouldings, timber panels and garden planting.
limitations: The roof and blind rear elevations are estimated below the parapets. The sole cleared photo documents the fronts closest to the landscaped garden, with portions hidden by vegetation.
The wall height, projected door relief, ramp grade and small planting layouts are approximate. The reconstruction covers the main house and immediate approach.
